acceptanceCriteria: Naming an unchanged .rb source and 2-3 spec examples returns test-kills-mutant rows with per-mutant verdict (killed/survived/error) and receipt.
Mutants are bounded by the existing caps and confined to the named spans or the executed lines when given.
Spec requirements trace to tests; exported revision never written.
body: GitHub #1354: RSpec mutation runs only in change mode on changed lines, so new or strengthened specs for an UNCHANGED source file get no test-kills-mutant rows (path mode gives history-consistent only). Request: a selector naming a source file, optional line spans, and the examples (file:line, #1271 selection) to judge; keep 12-mutant cap, row/invocation deadlines and per-mutant receipts; optionally restrict mutants to lines the cited examples execute or a caller span so unrelated survivors are not reported as test weakness.
title: prove --mutate: name an unchanged source file (and optional line spans) to mutate against cited RSpec examples (GH #1354 part 1)
